weather.note: 今天（8/25 週二）台北正常上班上課，市區維持「悶熱＋午後零星雷陣雨」，高溫 30–33°C。低壓帶今天白天起逐漸西移遠離，全台仍有局部短暫陣雨或雷雨，但南部與東半部那種連日豪雨的最強時段已經過去。　通勤重點：雨傘還是要帶，但今天不用像昨天那樣抓大雨的空檔，14:00–18:00 仍是雷陣雨機率最高的區間。　🌀 颱風「沙德爾」是本週真正的重點：氣象署預估最快今天（8/25）清晨升格為強烈颱風，沿太平洋高壓南側往西北移動，26 日接近琉球附近海面之後移速放慢，並有轉向西南、靠近台灣的趨勢。最快週三（8/26）發布海上颱風警報，週四（8/27）、週五（8/28）影響最劇烈，北部雨勢預計 27 日起明顯增加。　對你這週的實際影響：8/26（三）上午的半導體演講幾乎不受影響，8/27（四）下午那場就有變數了——如果週三真的發海警，週四的活動有可能改線上或延期，記得當天早上先確認一次。　⚠️ 昨天到今天南部災情仍在收尾：高雄那瑪夏、桃源、茂林、甲仙、六龜 5 區與屏東霧台、三地門、瑪家等 8 個原鄉今天續停班停課；嘉義縣、台南市、花蓮縣、台東縣已恢復正常。台北市未列入停班停課。

items.en: Bessent Unveils 'Operation Economic Outcast' — a Sanctions Campaign Aimed at Cutting Iran Off From the Global Economy
items.zh: 美財長貝森特公布「經濟棄兒行動」：全面加碼制裁，目標把伊朗逐出全球經濟體系
items.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent unveiled a sweeping sanctions campaign, branded "Operation Economic Outcast," designed to sever Iran's remaining links to the global economy. The plan widens the categories that trigger secondary sanctions on foreign entities and countries trading with Tehran, and adds new measures covering digital assets, gold, aviation, technology and shipping. Bessent described the goal as "economic asphyxiation of the regime," and framed it as leverage to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and end the war. He also conceded the programme carries real risk of disrupting global markets. Oil fell 2.4 percent on the day as traders read the announcement as already priced in.

items.en: Hegseth Says Kinetic Strikes Are 'By No Means' Ruled Out Around Hormuz as Iran Threatens to Seize Ships
items.zh: 美防長黑格塞斯不排除在荷姆茲海峽動武，伊朗同日警告將扣押違規船隻
items.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said Washington is not foreclosing the use of military force against Iran, stating that kinetic strikes "anywhere in the Strait of Hormuz or around Iran" remain on the table. Hours earlier Iran posted a warning that vessels breaching its transit arrangements for the strait could face fines, detention or confiscation. The exchange raises the stakes for a waterway that has carried unusually low traffic for weeks while global oil stockpiles are drawn down. The pairing of financial pressure from Treasury with an explicit military option from the Pentagon marks the sharpest escalation in the campaign so far.

items.en: New UK PM Andy Burnham Makes Kyiv His First Foreign Trip on Ukraine's 35th Independence Day
items.zh: 英國新首相柏納姆首次出訪選擇基輔，適逢烏克蘭獨立 35 週年並鬆綁飛彈技術
items.summary: Andy Burnham travelled to Kyiv on Monday for his first international trip as British prime minister, timed to Ukraine's 35th Independence Day. He met President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and co-chaired a meeting of Kyiv's allies with German Chancellor Friedrich Merz, while French President Emmanuel Macron joined by video link. The headline deliverable was technical rather than financial: Britain agreed to let missile maker MBDA release classified information on UK-made components of the SCALP cruise missile, letting France and Ukraine stand up local assembly lines. Britain has now pledged over 25 billion pounds in military and civilian support.

items.en: Israeli Strikes in Gaza Kill at Least Three Including a Four-Year-Old as IDF General Warns on Settler Violence
items.zh: 以軍空襲加薩至少 3 死含一名 4 歲男童，西岸將領警告屯墾區暴力恐引爆新一波恐攻
items.summary: Two Israeli airstrikes in the Gaza Strip killed at least three people, including a four-year-old boy, and wounded seven others, according to local reports. Separately, the Israel Defense Forces' senior general for the West Bank was reported to have warned the prime minister that settler violence could trigger a significant rise in Palestinian attacks — an unusually direct internal caution about a second front. The two developments together underline how the Iran confrontation has not displaced the older conflicts, and how thinly Israeli forces are now spread across Gaza, the West Bank and the northern border.

items.en: Typhoon Sadel Strengthens Toward Super Typhoon With Taiwan in the Possible Track Cone by Thursday
items.zh: 沙德爾升級強颱，最快週三發海警、週四週五對台影響最劇烈
items.summary: Taiwan's Central Weather Administration expects Typhoon Sadel, the season's 18th storm, to reach super typhoon strength as early as Tuesday morning. The system is tracking north-west along the southern rim of the Pacific High and should approach the waters near the Ryukyu Islands on Wednesday, after which its forward speed is expected to slow and its track to bend south-west toward Taiwan. Forecasters say a sea warning could be issued as soon as Wednesday, with Thursday and Friday the most disruptive days and rainfall increasing across northern Taiwan from Thursday. Southern mountain districts remain closed on Tuesday after days of torrential rain.

items.en: Google's A2A Protocol Joins the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation, Landing Beside Anthropic's MCP
items.zh: Google 的 A2A 協定加入 Linux 基金會 AAIF，與 Anthropic 的 MCP 同屬中立治理
items.summary: Google's Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol formally joined the Linux Foundation-directed Agentic AI Foundation, placing it under the same neutral governance as Anthropic's Model Context Protocol. AAIF now counts more than 250 members including AWS, Anthropic, Block, Bloomberg, Cloudflare, Google, Microsoft and OpenAI. The practical meaning is that the two competing layers of the agent stack — MCP for how a model reaches tools and data, A2A for how agents talk to each other — are now both vendor-neutral standards rather than proprietary hooks. That materially lowers the risk of building agent workflows on either one.

items.en: Claude Platform Ships General Availability for Computer Use, the Skills API and the Files API
items.zh: Claude 平台將電腦操作、Skills API、Files API 推上正式版，並加入網頁瀏覽能力
items.summary: Anthropic moved several Claude Platform capabilities out of preview into general availability: computer use, the Skills API and the Files API, with browser use added for web applications. Taken together these are the pieces an agent needs to operate software the way a person does — see a screen, click, read and write files, and carry reusable procedural knowledge between sessions. Claude Opus 5, released 24 July 2026, remains the top-ranked model on Artificial Analysis, leading both the Intelligence Index at 63 and the Agentic Index at 55.3. The GA label matters mostly for teams that need stability guarantees before shipping.

items.en: Weekend Reports Say Some Nvidia Chip Customers Face a 15% Price Increase, Adding Risk Into Wednesday's Print
items.zh: 傳輝達對部分客戶調漲晶片價格 15%，為週三財報再添變數
items.summary: Reports over the weekend indicated that some Nvidia chip customers may face a price increase of around 15 percent. The timing is awkward: the story landed two days before Nvidia's quarterly results, and investors read it two ways at once — as evidence of pricing power in a supply-tight market, and as a warning that hyperscaler capital expenditure budgets will buy fewer units than modelled. Nvidia fell 2.9 percent on Monday, its seventh consecutive decline and the longest such streak since September 2022. The iShares Semiconductor ETF slid 2.7 percent on the same session.

items.en: Norris Wins a Chaotic Final Dutch Grand Prix as Verstappen Crashes Out on the Opening Lap
items.zh: F1 荷蘭站告別戰：諾里斯奪冠，主場英雄韋斯塔潘首圈撞車退賽
items.summary: Lando Norris won the 2026 Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort, ahead of Mercedes pair Kimi Antonelli and George Russell. The race started on a damp circuit after pre-race rain and was red-flagged at the end of the opening lap when Max Verstappen crashed heavily into the barriers in front of his home crowd. This was the final scheduled running of the Dutch Grand Prix before it leaves the Formula One calendar, which gave the Verstappen retirement an extra sting for Zandvoort. Mercedes taking two of the three podium places reshaped both the drivers' and constructors' standings.

items.en: US Open Week Opens With Qualifying and the Revamped Mixed Doubles — Serena Williams and Alcaraz Await a Qualifier
items.zh: 美網開打：資格賽與改制混雙同步登場，小威廉絲與阿爾卡拉斯首輪對手待定
items.summary: The 2026 US Open got under way at Flushing Meadows on Monday with singles qualifying and the reformatted mixed doubles championship, which runs 24 to 26 August. Serena Williams and Carlos Alcaraz, handed a wild card on 21 August, will open against a team that comes through qualifying, so their first opponent was still unknown at the start of the week. The event's rescheduling ahead of the main draw and a much larger purse are what pulled singles stars into a competition they had ignored for years. Qualifying runs through Thursday 27 August.

items.en: Premier League Opens With Upsets: Hull City Beat Manchester United 2-0, Leeds Win at Nottingham Forest
items.zh: 英超開幕週：升班馬赫爾城 2-0 擊敗曼聯，里茲聯客場 1-0 拿下諾丁漢森林
items.summary: The 2026-27 Premier League season opened on Saturday 22 August with a run of unexpected results. Newly promoted Hull City beat Manchester United 2-0, Everton beat Crystal Palace 2-0, Ipswich Town edged Sunderland 2-1, and Leeds United won 1-0 away at Nottingham Forest. The opening weekend also featured Brentford against Tottenham Hotspur. For a first matchweek, the pattern was unusually hostile to the established sides, and Manchester United in particular begin the campaign under immediate pressure after losing to a promoted club at the first opportunity.

items.en: Teens Spend About 1.5 Hours a Day on Phones During School Hours, JAMA Pediatrics Study Finds
items.zh: 研究：青少年平均每個上學日花 1.5 小時滑手機，四分之一的人超過兩小時
items.summary: A study published in JAMA Pediatrics found that teenagers spend an average of about 1.5 hours on their phones during each school day, with roughly a quarter of students logging more than two hours. Social media and messaging apps accounted for close to a quarter of the school day for heavy users. Girls and older students aged 16 to 18 averaged around half an hour above the mean, while Latino and multiracial students averaged about 15 minutes above it. The researchers framed the finding less as a discipline problem than as evidence about how attention is actually distributed during instruction.

items.en: Strict School Phone Bans Showed No Measurable Difference in Wellbeing or Grades Across 1,200 Students
items.zh: 逾 1,200 名學生研究：嚴格禁手機的學校，心理健康與成績沒有明顯比較好
items.summary: In a study of more than 1,200 students, researchers found no measurable differences in mental health, academic performance or general wellbeing between schools operating strict phone bans and those without them. The result cuts against the intuition driving a wave of legislation — Rhode Island's school phone ban, for instance, takes effect in August 2026. Researchers suggest the ban may be targeting the wrong variable: total daily use outside school hours, and what the phone is actually used for, appear to matter more than whether the device sits in a locker during lessons.

items.en: Eight-Year Finnish Study Finds More Childhood Screen Time Linked to Better Cognitive Processing as Teenagers
items.zh: 芬蘭 8 年追蹤研究：童年螢幕時間較多者，青少年期的認知處理速度反而較好
items.summary: An eight-year Finnish longitudinal study reported that children who spent more time on screens tended to show better cognitive processing as teenagers — a result that runs against the dominant assumption in screen-time debates. The authors are careful about causation: heavier screen use correlates with other advantages, and the measure captures processing speed rather than attention, mood or sleep. Read alongside the JAMA Pediatrics and phone-ban findings, the emerging picture is that how much screen time matters far less than which activity it is, and what that activity displaces.

items.en: Nvidia Reports Wednesday After the Bell on a Seven-Session Losing Streak, Its Longest Since 2022
items.zh: 輝達 8/26 盤後財報：帶著 2022 年以來最長的連七黑走進這場財報
items.summary: Nvidia reports quarterly results on Wednesday after the close, and heads into the print having fallen for seven consecutive sessions, the longest such run since September 2022. Consensus sits near 92 billion dollars of revenue against the company's own guidance of roughly 91 billion. The number itself is not the swing factor: what matters is Blackwell yield and shipment cadence, what management says about the next-generation Rubin, and any change of tone on China. Taiwan's AI supply chain — TSMC, Hon Hai, Wistron, Wiwynn, Quanta, Auras — will react on Thursday morning Taipei time.

items.en: Memory Stocks Tumble as Another Chinese DRAM Maker Files for a Shanghai IPO; Micron Falls 5.8%
items.zh: 又一家中國記憶體廠遞件上海 IPO，記憶體族群重挫，美光單日跌 5.8%
items.summary: Memory names led Monday's semiconductor sell-off after another Chinese memory-chip company filed for an initial public offering in Shanghai. Micron fell 5.8 percent and Sandisk also tumbled, while AMD lost more than 3 percent and Broadcom more than 2 percent. The iShares Semiconductor ETF slid 2.7 percent. The market read the filing as evidence that Chinese domestic capacity in commodity DRAM is being capitalised faster than expected, which threatens the back half of the current pricing cycle. This lands on top of last week's downgrades of Taiwanese memory names as Q3 contract price growth narrowed.

items.en: Google's New DeepMind Chief Koray Kavukcuoglu Inherits a Race to Catch OpenAI and Anthropic
items.zh: Google DeepMind 新掌門人 Kavukcuoglu 接手的第一個任務：追上 OpenAI 與 Anthropic
items.summary: Koray Kavukcuoglu takes over AI leadership at Google with Gemini still fighting for share against OpenAI and Anthropic in the enterprise and developer markets, where switching costs are rising as teams build on agent frameworks. The strategic question for Google is whether to compete on raw model benchmarks or on distribution through Workspace, Android and Cloud, where it has structural advantages neither rival can match. The A2A protocol handover to the Linux Foundation this month reads as part of the same answer: win the plumbing, then win the workloads that run on it.

items.en: YOASOBI Announce a 10-City Asia Dome & Stadium Tour — Taipei Dome Is on the List, Reportedly January 2027
items.zh: 🔥 YOASOBI 宣布亞洲 10 城巨蛋巡演，台北大巨蛋在列，傳 2027 年 1 月開唱
items.summary: YOASOBI announced the "YOASOBI ASIA 10-CITY DOME & STADIUM TOUR 2026-2027," with Taipei Dome named among the ten venues. Taiwanese media report the Taipei date as January 2027, which would make YOASOBI the first Japanese act to headline the Taipei Dome. The routing covers Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya, Fukuoka and Sapporo in Japan plus Taipei, Seoul, Hong Kong, Singapore and one city still undisclosed. Exact dates, pricing and the ticketing platform have not been released — the organisers have asked fans to wait. Worth setting an alert now rather than chasing the on-sale later.

items.en: Official HIGE DANdism Play Taipei Arena This Saturday and Sunday, 29-30 August — Typhoon Sadel Is the Wildcard
items.zh: 🎫 本週末：Official髭男dism 台北小巨蛋 8/29–30 兩場，但要留意沙德爾颱風
items.summary: Official HIGE DANdism play two nights at Taipei Arena on 29 and 30 August, both starting at 18:00, as part of the OFFICIAL HIGE DANDISM ASIA TOUR 2026. Tickets ranged from NT$800 to NT$4,880, promoted by AEG Presents Asia and Kham Inc. The complication this year is weather: Typhoon Sadel is forecast to affect Taiwan most severely on Thursday and Friday, and while the storm should be clearing by the weekend, anyone travelling to Taipei for these shows should watch transport advisories from Wednesday onward and keep the promoter's page open.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE's Ringo Jam Tour 'SHADOWS' Enters Its Second Ticket Window, 29 August to 1 September
items.zh: Mrs. GREEN APPLE「Ringo Jam Tour SHADOWS」第二階段抽選 8/29–9/1 開放申請
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE's Ringo Jam Tour "SHADOWS" has a second ticket application window running 29 August to 1 September, following the first window that closed on 19 August. The band wrapped the "Zenjin Mito to I/mutable" interlude tour on 5 July, making SHADOWS the autumn fan-club run. No Taiwan, Hong Kong or other overseas dates have been announced for this leg, so the only route in is the Japanese fan-club lottery. The sixth original album is still scheduled for 30 September, which the tour is built around.
items.source: Mrs. GREEN APPLE 官方網站

items.en: Kenshi Yonezu's '2026 TOUR / GHOST' Runs 6 November to 17 December Across Six Japanese Cities
items.zh: 米津玄師「2026 TOUR / GHOST」11/6–12/17 全日本 6 城 14 場，一般售票進行中
items.summary: Kenshi Yonezu's "2026 TOUR / GHOST" runs from 6 November to 17 December across six Japanese cities for fourteen shows, with general ticketing already open. There are no announced dates in Taiwan, Hong Kong or anywhere else outside Japan for this cycle, so attending means travelling — and December in Japan means booking flights and accommodation well ahead of the domestic winter travel peak. If a Japan trip is on the table this winter, this tour is the single strongest reason on the current J-pop calendar to fix the dates now rather than later.

items.en: Fujii Kaze Brings the Prema World Tour to Kaohsiung on 31 October — Still the Only Confirmed Taiwan Stadium Show
items.zh: 藤井風 Prema World Tour 高雄國家體育場 10/31，香港場已取消，台灣場成為區域唯一
items.summary: Fujii Kaze plays Kaohsiung National Stadium on 31 October as part of the Prema World Tour. The Hong Kong leg was cancelled without advance notice, which leaves the Kaohsiung date as the only confirmed stadium show for this tour in the region — and makes it materially harder to get in as Hong Kong ticket holders look for alternatives. Kaohsiung National Stadium seats roughly 55,000, so capacity is not the binding constraint; timing is. Two months out is the point at which resale supply is thinnest and prices are worst, so decide now if you want to go.

market.note: ★ 昨天（8/24）台美兩邊都跌，而且是同一個原因：半導體。　【台股 8/24】加權指數開高走低，終場收 44,762.32 點、下跌 461.97 點（-1.02%），一天之內同時丟掉 45,000 大關與季線，成交金額縮到 6,519.04 億元（前一交易日約 7,200 億）。台積電收 2,375 元、跌 35 元（-1.45%），盤中最深跌到 2,385；台達電最低 1,710 元、跌 40 元；鴻海在平盤 245.5 元附近游走。　資金明顯從電子轉進傳產：航運是唯一的亮點，益航（2601）、中櫃（2613）、四維航（5608）三檔亮燈漲停，萬海（2615）與慧洋-KY（2637）各漲近 4%，陽明（2609）漲約 3%，長榮（2603）漲約 1%。另一邊，電子零組件與 PCB 賣壓較重，ABF 載板的南電、欣興都下跌。　三大法人合計賣超 163.77 億元：外資由買轉賣、單日賣超 157.51 億，自營商賣超 43.32 億，只有投信小買。但外資的賣是有選擇性的——同一天反手大買力積電（6770）38,095 張，居買超第一，接著是陽明 30,651 張、仁寶 28,426 張、鼎元 13,702 張、兆豐金 12,920 張。　【美股 8/25 凌晨】三大指數分歧：道瓊收 53,417.16 點、漲 140.15 點（+0.26%），是唯一收紅的主要指數；S&P 500 收 7,652.86（-0.28%）；那斯達克收 25,980.19（-0.76%）。拖累的是晶片股：美光 -5.8%（另一家中國記憶體廠遞件上海 IPO）、AMD 跌逾 3%、博通跌逾 2%、輝達 -2.9%（連七黑，2022 年 9 月以來最長），費城半導體 ETF（SOXX）-2.7%。反過來，消費防禦類股是當日最強族群。黃金漲 0.76% 至 4,650.64 美元，原油大跌 2.39% 至 84.98 美元（貝森特制裁被解讀為利空出盡），VIX 升到 15.85（+4.76%），10 年期公債殖利率降到 4.70%。　【加密】比特幣週一開在 77,727.62 美元、美東早盤一度衝到 79,106.77，是 5 月以來最高；以太幣同期從 2,463.09 走高到 2,507.22，近即時報價約 2,478。上週那波由 CLARITY Act 與財政部回購消息帶動的漲勢還沒熄火，分析師下一個看的關卡是 8 萬美元。
market.highlight: 🔭 今天先知道這三件事就好：　① 【明天 8/26 美股盤後】輝達 NVDA 財報 —— 本週唯一的重量級催化劑，而且情勢比上週更緊張。輝達已經連七個交易日下跌（2022 年 9 月以來最長），週末又傳出對部分客戶調漲晶片價格 15%。市場共識營收約 920 億美元、公司財測約 910 億。真正的看點不是數字有沒有超標，而是 Blackwell 良率與出貨節奏、黃仁勳怎麼講下一代 Rubin，以及對中國市場的說法。台股的 AI 供應鏈（台積電、鴻海、緯創、緯穎、廣達、奇鋐）會在 8/27（四）早上直接反應——但 8/27 剛好也是颱風影響最劇的一天，兩件事會疊在一起。　② 【記憶體循環出現第二個裂縫】上週是法人對華邦電、南亞科等四檔降評、Q3 DRAM 合約價季增收斂到 13–18%；昨天又多一件：另一家中國記憶體廠遞件上海 IPO，直接把美光打掉 5.8%。單獨看每一件都不大，但連起來是同一個訊號——這輪漲價還在，但「加速度」正在被中國新產能追上。如果你在追記憶體族群（南亞科、華邦電、旺宏都在你的觀察清單裡），這個轉折比任何單日漲停都值得記。　③ 【本週剩下的美國數據】今天 8/25 消費者信心與新屋銷售，週末前還有 7 月個人所得與支出、PCE 物價、耐久財訂單，以及非農年度修正。PCE 是聯準會最在意的通膨指標，會直接影響降息路徑的定價。聯準會的 Jackson Hole 年會也在本週，講話內容同樣要留意。　🇹🇼 台股今天開盤留意：昨天丟了 45,000 與季線，量能同時縮到 6,519 億——「破線＋縮量」通常代表沒人急著接，而不是恐慌性賣壓。真正要看的是今天量能有沒有回來。資金昨天從電子跑到航運（三檔漲停），如果今天航運續強、電子繼續失血，那就不是一天的輪動而是月底的減碼。
